terminal_name: Beira FSRU / Inhassoro FSRU (monitor-list candidates, not in GEM)
issue: Discovery sweep re-examined the two Nov-2025 state FSRU concession candidates (Beira, Inhassoro) against the add bar with fresh searches. MATERIAL ADVANCE since the update agent's judgment: on April 8, 2026 the four state shareholders (CFM, ENH, EDM, HCB) incorporated the concession SPV — Servicos de Logistica Integrada de Gas Natural de Mocambique, S.A. (SLIGM) — and signed a Joint Development Agreement for the FSRU (verified: https://www.cfm.co.mz/en/2026/04/17/cfm-assina-acordo-de-sociedade-para-garantir-fornecimento-de-gas-domestico/, tokens 'SLIGM', 'Inhambane'; https://clubofmozambique.com/news/mozambique-enh-cfm-and-hcb-sign-agreement-to-establish-gas-logistics-company/, token 'gas logistics'). One-vs-two terminals and the FSRU anchorage site cannot be corroborated by >=2 independent sources, and there is still no capacity, no vessel, no commercial/technical partner (government selection pending), no development plan or FID timeline.
suggested_action: Keep both as monitor entries (already staged by the update agent in mozambique.monitor.json — not re-staged here to avoid duplication), but treat as NEAR-BAR: promote to new_terminal candidate(s) as soon as the siting/configuration (one FSRU at Inhassoro vs separate Beira unit), a partner selection, or a capacity/vessel announcement firms up. Next batch should update the monitor entries' current_state with the April 2026 SLIGM incorporation + JDA.
